advancedtechnologyservices-advancedtechn.description: Founded in 1985, ATS is a company with a presence in the United States, Mexico and the United Kingdom. We are professionals in Industrial Maintenance and we make factories run better. Fundada en 1985, ATS es una empresa con presencia en los Estados Unidos, México y el Reino Unido. Principal Duties/Responsibilities: To Live and Lead Safety · Manages the Site Safety Program and ensures all policies are being followed by employees · Drives housekeeping standards, including 5S · Demonstrates leadership for employee safety and/wellness through Beyond Zero initiatives To Inspire and Provide Clarity on Vision and Strategy · Develops and displays a thorough understanding of site-level and company-wide strategic initiatives · Actively supports positive change, working with the site staff to ensure understanding and effective implementation of new processes and procedures · Communicates with the team to promote an understanding of the relationship between site actions and results and overall strategic objectives To Own Our ATS Culture · Drives day-to-day execution of team-related responsibilities/team priorities using the leadership competencies that support our ATS culture · Displays behaviors that align with being self-motivated and emotionally intelligent To Support Our Employees’ Learning and Growth · Manages employee performance and provides development opportunities · Mentors/coaches employees regarding career planning, training, skills development using ongoing one-on-one communication To Ensure and Drive our Business Results · Leads and ensures the Operating System is understood, reinforced, and embedded · Assists Site Manager in measuring and reporting key maintenance performance indicators including root cause analyses. We also offer market leading benefit programs including Medical, Dental and Vision plans, PTO, a 401k retirement plans with employer matching, tuition reimbursement, and more. cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:042.description: With over 58 stores and the largest avocational cooking program in the US, Sur La Table offers an unsurpassed selection of exclusive and premium-quality goods for the kitchen and table – and the culinary expertise and inspiration to go along with it. Whether the job entails interacting with our customers, driving digital growth, or providing vital behind-the-scenes support, we’re all here for the same reason – to roll up our sleeves and create happiness through cooking and sharing good food. Position Overview As a Chef Instructor, Pastry at Sur La Table, you are the in-store expert and advocate for all things baking and pastry arts. You deliver #bestincenter service, a company-wide standard for excellence in service, by sharing specialized knowledge in pastry techniques, baking fundamentals, and personalized instruction that supports all company initiatives. The Chef Instructor, Pastry plays a key role in inspiring a love for baking while driving sales of bakeware, mixers, and decorating tools through hands-on pastry classes and engaging culinary instruction. Key Responsibilities Customer Experience & Brand Representation · Represent Sur La Table’s brand and culture by creating memorable, educational experiences that inspire repeat visits and customer loyalty. · Deliver an exceptional in-store culinary experience focused on pastry and baking classes that reflects Sur La Table’s passion for food, teaching, and high standards, while following the provided recipes and game plans to ensure consistency and quality. · Communicate technical concepts and advanced pastry skills in a clear, encouraging, and approachable manner. · Maintains expertise by staying current on products, actively engaging in available training, and independently seeking out additional resources. Sales & Business Performance · Drive sales by upholding kitchen standards, encouraging second class sign-ups through strong customer engagement, and promoting retail items used or featured in class. · Deliver class revenue goals by ensuring high enrollment, positive reviews, and guest return rates. · Consistently meet or exceed culinary program goals by delivering exceptional classes that drive customer engagement and sales. Performance is measured by key KPIs such as second-class sign-ups, retail culinary product sales, and guest feedback through Google reviews. Team Engagement & Store Support · Assist in setting up and breakdown of classes including organizing mise en place, prepping ingredients, and cleaning workstations. · Clean and sanitize dishes and equipment promptly to ensure smooth kitchen operations. · Assist with restocking, organizing, and maintaining kitchen supplies and tools to support overall store readiness. Operations & Compliance · Ensure compliance with food safety standards, local health codes, and sanitation regulations. · Properly handle all tools, ingredients, and kitchen equipment to maintain a safe and efficient work environment. · Maintain accurate inventory levels, minimize shrink, and control supply and culinary expenses. · May handle liquor, wine, and beer in compliance with state and location alcohol regulations, company policies, including enforcing age restrictions. · Ensure store safety and cleanliness, addressing any maintenance needs promptly. · Adhere to applicable wage and hour laws. Accurately records time worked according to SLT Policy. · Model and ensure consistent adherence to all Sur La Table policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs). jobgether-jobgether:lever:1958ebb6-3968-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Software Engineer based in Brazil. This is a hands-on senior engineering role focused on building and operating high-performance, real-time software systems for next-generation transportation infrastructure. You will work at the core of a platform that combines roadway technology, sensors, data infrastructure, and AI-enabled analytics to deliver real-time operational insights. The role offers broad ownership across system design, algorithm development, data processing, deployment, and ongoing operations. You will develop production-grade services and algorithms primarily in C++, while also working with Go, Python, cloud infrastructure, and modern deployment technologies. A key part of the role involves transforming historic and simulated data into rigorous testing and validation workflows before systems reach live environments. You will work independently in an environment that values initiative, thoughtful use of AI-assisted development tools, strong engineering judgment, and end-to-end ownership. This is an opportunity to contribute to complex systems that can directly improve the safety, efficiency, and intelligence of modern transportation networks. Translate high-level and sometimes ambiguous requirements into robust system designs, technical solutions, and production-ready implementations. Own features and systems throughout their complete lifecycle, from initial development and testing through production deployment, monitoring, and ongoing operations and maintenance. Design, build, tune, and operate high-throughput, low-latency services using C++, Go, and Python. Develop and optimize production-facing algorithms for tracking, inference, sensor fusion, and other real-time intelligence use cases. Use historic and simulated datasets to iterate, test, tune, and rigorously validate algorithms and system behavior before live deployment. Design and implement high-performance inter-application communication mechanisms and robust data interfaces for real-time data exchange. Optimize data structures, Protobuf serialization, Redis Streams, and related technologies for real-time processing workloads. Architect and manage data pipelines covering sensor ingestion, transformation, storage, processing, and downstream delivery. Build REST APIs and integrate internal and external services to support reliable platform functionality. Implement comprehensive observability across performance-critical applications, including monitoring, logging, alerting, and operational diagnostics. Deploy and operate containerized services on Kubernetes using technologies such as Argo and Helm within GCP environments. Develop and maintain technical documentation, system documentation, operational runbooks, and integration specifications. Collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders and clearly communicate architectural decisions and trade-offs. Contribute to a high-trust engineering culture where initiative, experimentation, collaboration, and strong technical ideas are encouraged. Requirements 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, ideally as a versatile generalist with a strong backend and systems focus. Deep experience designing, building, tuning, and operating real-time systems. Strong proficiency in C++, with demonstrated experience implementing high-performance, low-latency algorithms in production environments. Proficiency in Python for prototyping, experimentation, numerical computing, or algorithm development. Demonstrated ability to use historic and simulated data to rapidly iterate on algorithms, validate system behavior, and improve production logic. Strong understanding of data interfaces, including inter-process communication, high-speed messaging protocols, and strict, reliable interfaces between applications. jobgether-jobgether:lever:89d9812f-784f-.title: Lead Site Reliability Engineer - Imunify Reliability Platform
jobgether-jobgether:lever:89d9812f-784f-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Lead Site Reliability Engineer - Imunify Reliability Platform based in Mexico. This is a greenfield SRE leadership opportunity within a large-scale, security-focused product environment. You will define what “healthy” means across roughly 70 components spanning cloud services and customer-hosted agents. You will establish SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, monitoring standards, alerting, and escalation practices from the ground up. Your work will directly improve the ability to detect silent security-control degradation before it becomes a widespread customer-impacting issue. You will collaborate closely with engineering leads and senior engineers while building the telemetry and reliability platform yourself. The environment is remote-first, async, technically demanding, and focused on measurable outcomes rather than dashboards for their own sake. This is an opportunity to shape the reliability culture and foundations of a major security product. Define and establish meaningful SLIs for approximately 70 product components, working with squad leads and senior engineers to agree on ownership, measurement, tiering, SLOs, and error budgets. Develop a reliability taxonomy covering service availability and latency, fleet reachability and configuration convergence, security-control efficacy, artifact delivery, and telemetry pipeline health. Ensure reliability indicators are independently measurable and cannot be disabled by the same failure they are intended to detect. Design and build the telemetry collection pipeline for customer-hosted agents and cloud services, balancing push-based collection, sampling, privacy constraints, data quality, and cardinality. Extend instrumentation across Python, Go, and Rust components in collaboration with product engineering teams. Consolidate existing dashboards, queries, and reporting mechanisms into a smaller, more reliable observability platform, retiring tooling that does not provide meaningful operational value. Implement symptom-based, SLO-driven alerting with multi-window burn-rate principles and clear page, ticket, and dashboard classifications. Ensure every production alert has a defined owner, documented failure mode, and actionable runbook. Establish ongoing alert-quality practices, including periodic reviews, measurable actionable-alert rates, and deliberate removal of unnecessary alerts. Build a machine-readable ownership and escalation model that routes incidents to the appropriate engineering squads. Establish severity definitions, acknowledgement expectations, follow-the-sun escalation practices, and clean handoff procedures across multiple time zones. Strengthen incident command and blameless postmortem practices, including reliable timelines, ownership, and follow-through on corrective actions. Coach engineering squads to own their own operational responsibilities and paging rather than becoming a centralized buffer for other teams' alerts. Deliver measurable reliability outcomes over the first year, including complete SLI ownership, production telemetry, tiered alerting, squad on-call adoption, and a significant reduction in the time required to detect silent security-control degradation. Requirements Substantial production engineering or SRE experience, including experience defining and implementing an SLO framework rather than simply operating within an existing one. Strong Python skills and the ability to read and modify Go or Rust code when implementing instrumentation and reliability improvements. Strong hands-on experience with time-series and event telemetry at scale, including Prometheus/OpenMetrics, Grafana, Alertmanager-class routing systems, and columnar or high-cardinality data stores such as ClickHouse or equivalent technologies. Experience debugging distributed systems running on bare metal and long-lived hosts; this role requires more than Kub

jobgether-jobgether:lever:e03c8a5a-cc29-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director of Operations & Service Growth based in India. This is a high-impact leadership role combining business building, commercial growth, and hands-on operational management. You will turn an approved business vision into an executable roadmap while launching and scaling a technology-enabled service operation. The role combines strategic ownership with direct involvement in sales, service delivery, partnerships, and operational execution. You will oversee multi-location operations and work through Area and Location Managers to maintain consistent service quality and customer outcomes. A key focus will be improving digital conversion, retention, operational efficiency, and contribution margins. You will also build scalable systems that reduce manual work and create more predictable, repeatable operations. This opportunity is ideal for an entrepreneurial operator who enjoys building new businesses while simultaneously improving established operations. Translate an approved business vision into a clear, executable strategy, roadmap, operating model, and measurable priorities. Lead the launch and early development of a new technology-enabled service business, taking ownership of initial sales, service, and operating processes. Build and strengthen customer, merchant, delivery-partner, and other strategic networks required to support business growth. Provide hands-on, COO-level leadership across multi-location operations, working through Area and Location Managers to ensure consistent execution. Establish clear operational standards, performance expectations, and accountability mechanisms across locations and teams. Own service quality, speed, customer experience, and business outcomes across the operating network. Identify operational bottlenecks and implement practical solutions that improve efficiency, reliability, and scalability. Drive improvements in online sales conversion, customer retention, digital performance, and contribution margin. Use AI, analytics, automation, and workflow tools to improve decision-making and reduce dependence on manual follow-up and individual intervention. Balance strategic growth initiatives with field-level execution, continuously identifying opportunities to improve both the business model and day-to-day operations. Develop managers and strengthen their ability to lead teams, meet performance expectations, and operate independently. Requirements Significant senior-level experience in operations, commercial leadership, business development, or a closely related field. Demonstrated track record of building, launching, scaling, or significantly improving a business, service operation, or distributed network. Strong experience in multi-location restaurant, delivery, logistics, hospitality, or service-based operations. Proven business development and partnership experience, with the ability to build relationships that generate commercial value. Strong understanding of operational performance, customer experience, service quality, and commercial growth. Hands-on experience using AI, analytics, automation, and workflow tools to improve business processes and decision-making. Strong leadership skills with experience managing managers, setting expectations, measuring performance, and developing team capability. Ability to operate comfortably across both high-level strategy and hands-on operational execution. Experience with online sales, e-commerce growth, digital conversion, or customer retention is a plus. Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to operate effectively in environments where processes are still being built and refined. Strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to personally address operational challenges when necessary. Excellent communication, influencing, and decision-making abilities. jobgether-jobgether:lever:f622fb80-35a0-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Product Designer, Federal Modernization based in United States. This is a remote opportunity to shape mission-critical digital products supporting complex federal investigative and data-driven operations. You’ll combine deep UX expertise with strong visual design skills to turn sophisticated workflows and large volumes of data into intuitive experiences. The role is highly client-facing, with direct collaboration across government stakeholders, product managers, engineers, and delivery teams. You’ll contribute across the full design lifecycle, from research and discovery through prototyping, testing, implementation, and iteration. Your work will help simplify complex processes, improve information discovery, and strengthen operational decision-making in secure enterprise environments. You’ll operate as a hands-on design leader and trusted advisor within a collaborative consulting and Agile delivery environment. This role offers the opportunity to make a tangible impact on federal modernization while working on challenging, high-visibility digital transformation initiatives. Lead end-to-end product design activities for mission-critical federal digital products, from discovery and research through delivery and continuous improvement. Create wireframes, journey maps, workflows, prototypes, and high-fidelity visual designs that address complex user and business needs. Translate sophisticated requirements, investigative workflows, and data-intensive use cases into intuitive, accessible, and effective user experiences. Conduct stakeholder interviews, user research, usability testing, and other discovery activities to validate assumptions and inform design decisions. Simplify complex workflows and data-rich environments through thoughtful interaction design, information architecture, navigation, and visual hierarchy. Develop and maintain reusable design patterns, standards, and design-system components to ensure consistency across products and experiences. Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, business analysts, and other delivery team members throughout the product lifecycle. Present design concepts, recommendations, prototypes, and design rationale clearly to government and client stakeholders. Incorporate feedback and usability findings into iterative design improvements while supporting Agile delivery teams. Ensure digital experiences align with accessibility best practices, security requirements, enterprise standards, and established user-centered design principles. Serve as a trusted design partner in client engagements, helping stakeholders navigate complex product and user experience challenges. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent professional experience. 8+ years of professional experience in UX, UI, product design, or a closely related discipline. Previous consulting experience in a client-facing environment, with confidence working directly with senior stakeholders. Demonstrated experience designing digital solutions for U.S. Federal Government agencies. Strong portfolio showcasing both user experience and visual design capabilities across complex digital products. Advanced proficiency with modern design and prototyping tools, particularly Figma and Adobe Creative Suite . Hands-on experience with user research, stakeholder interviews, prototyping, usability testing, interaction design, and iterative product development. Strong understanding of human-centered and user-centered design methodologies, information architecture, and accessibility best practices. Ability to transform complex requirements and data-heavy workflows into clear, intuitive, and visually compelling experiences.
